models.task_type: antibacterial peptide classification / antimicrobial peptide classification
models.architecture_or_algorithm: Random Forest, Extra Trees, Support Vector Classifier using amino acid binary profile of terminal residues and composition features; hybrid approach with BLAST and motif-based methods
models.input_features: amino acid binary profile of terminal residues, various composition features (AAC, PCP, APAAC, etc.)
models.candidate_reason: Provides a method for predicting antibacterial peptides against three bacterial groups, with web server, standalone package, and comparison with existing tools. Available code and dataset.

models.task_type: antibacterial peptide classification and activity prediction
models.architecture_or_algorithm: deep forest (cascading architecture similar to deep neural networks)
models.input_features: multiple effective peptide descriptors capturing compositional features and physicochemical properties
models.dataset_source_or_link: not_reported_in_available_evidence (elaborate dataset constructed from public sources, no direct download link)
models.candidate_reason: Proposes a three-stage framework for ABP identification and activity prediction, with web server, and claims state-of-the-art performance.
Mentioned in review as an AMP prediction model capable of species-specific antibacterial activity prediction (Level 3/4).

models.architecture_or_algorithm: Conditional Variational Autoencoder (CVAE) with Transformer encoder-decoder, hidden diffusion model with BERT-Encoder, MIC predictor (ESM embedding + MLP); multi-stage pretraining and fine-tuning
models.input_features: Amino acid sequences, target physicochemical properties (molecular weight, pI, gravy, aromaticity, instability index, disulfide bonds, molecular volume, secondary structure fractions), pathogen-specific labels
models.dataset_source_or_link: UniProt (uniprotkb_reviewed_true_2024_12_17.fasta) for pretraining; GRAMPA for fine-tuning and MIC training
models.candidate_reason: Novel generative framework with MIC predictor; can be benchmarked against other AMP design/prediction tools.
blocking_issues: No public web server or weights

models.architecture_or_algorithm: Machine learning classifiers using position relative incidence and statistical moments; 10-fold cross-validation
models.input_features: Sequence-based features extracted via position relative incidence and statistical moments
models.candidate_reason: Simple ML-based AMP classifier with reported accuracy of 95.43%; could serve as baseline.
blocking_issues: No web server or detailed algorithm description

datasets.dataset_source: Curated from APD3, AntiBP2, dbAMP 2.0, CAMPR3, DRAMP, ABP-Finder

datasets.dataset_source: Microbial smORF catalogues screened with three ACP and two AMP prediction tools
datasets.evidence: We screened a total of 124,051,427 microbial peptides ... and identified 40,251 non-toxic peptides that display dual activity.

metrics.usage: Area under the ROC curve for AntiBP3 prediction of antibacterial peptides; AUC 0.93 (GP), 0.98 (GN), 0.94 (GV)
metrics.evidence: Our model ... achieved maximum AUC 0.93, 0.98, and 0.94 for GP, GN, and GV ABPs, respectively.

metrics.usage: Matthews correlation coefficient for AntiBP3 (0.75 for GP ABPs using AAC-based features)
metrics.evidence: MCC of 0.75 for GP ABPs using AAC-based features.

metrics.usage: Overall accuracy for AMPActiPred Stage 1 ABP identification (87.6%)
metrics.evidence: AMPActiPred focuses on ABP identification, achieving an Accuracy of 87.6% and an MCC of 0.742.

metrics.usage: Geometric mean for multi-species ABP activity prediction in AMPActiPred (82.8%)
metrics.evidence: AMPActiPred achieved an average GMean at 82.8% in identifying ABPs targeting 10 bacterial species.

metrics.usage: Pearson correlation coefficient for activity level prediction in AMPActiPred (0.722)
metrics.evidence: AMPActiPred demonstrates robust predictive capabilities for ABP activity levels with an average PCC of 0.722.

metrics.usage: AMP classification accuracy for Malebary-Khan predictor (95.43%)
metrics.evidence: An overall accuracy of 95.43% was achieved.

important_evidence: AntiBP3 achieved AUC 0.93 (GP), 0.98 (GN), 0.94 (GV) and MCC 0.75; web server, standalone, and pip package available.
AMPActiPred achieved 87.6% accuracy and 0.742 MCC for ABP identification; GMean 82.8% for 10-species activity prediction.
Unnamed CVAE-diffusion framework generates AMPs with programmable physicochemical properties and MIC prediction; code not available.
AntiBP3 training dataset available on Zenodo (10.5281/zenodo.19911030) with 930 GP, 1455 GN, 8985 GV positive ABPs.
